svg.aria-label: Ferry.make: inputs wait in one bounded queue; a batch leaves when it holds maxBatchSize inputs or when its oldest input has waited maxBatchDelay; at most two batch calls run; when the queue is full a new call is rejected at once.
svg.text: one queue · leaves when full or due · ≤ maxInFlightBatches calls
a batch leaves when maxBatchSize (4) inputs wait, or maxBatchDelay after its oldest; a full queue rejects at once
